:::{#exm-bernoulli-lik-general}

#### Likelihood of three binary outcomes

Suppose $\vy = (1, 0, 1)$ with event probabilities $\vpi = (0.8, 0.3, 0.6)$.
The code below computes the likelihood from the formula of @thm-bernoulli-lik-general,
and as the product of the three Bernoulli probabilities from `dbinom()`:

```{r}
#| label: exm-bernoulli-lik-general-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_y <- c(1, 0, 1)
ex_pi <- c(0.8, 0.3, 0.6)
ex_lik_formula <- prod(ex_pi^ex_y * (1 - ex_pi)^(1 - ex_y))
ex_lik_dbinom <- prod(dbinom(ex_y, size = 1, prob = ex_pi))
```

The formula gives `r round(ex_lik_formula, 4)`
and `dbinom()` gives `r round(ex_lik_dbinom, 4)`,
so the two agree.

:::
